title: PNP has become 'enforcement arm of politicians', says VP Sara
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte slammed the Philippine National Police (PNP) on Saturday, claiming the organization has become "the enforcement arm of politicians."

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte slammed the Philippine National Police (PNP) on Saturday, claiming the organization has become "the enforcement arm of politicians."

"It would be in the best interest of the Philippine National Police (PNP), as an institution, for its Chief to refrain from paying lip service to the claim that the organization is apolitical—a claim that virtually every Filipino knows to be untrue. The PNP, in practice, has become the enforcement arm of politicians," said Duterte in a statement.
Duterte made the claim after the PNP earlier said that there was "no rescue or release" of a former household staff member of the Vice President and four other individuals.
The PNP pointed out that the concerned former staff members of Duterte were not being held captive when police accompanied their lawyers to a hotel in Taguig City on November 17.
However, Duterte pointed out that the PNP did not conduct the proper inquiry on the matter.
"Such a premature conclusion, reached without first establishing the facts, raises serious concerns about the institution’s impartiality and its commitment to due process," Duterte said.

Further, the Vice President said that she has five "documented threats" made by police against her. Yet, she cannot present the threats amid her impeachment trial "because the prosecution maliciously withdrew the charge of grave threats."
Duterte also reiterated that she is concerned for her personal safety.

"When I say that I do not feel safe in this country, I speak not only for myself but also for the many Filipinos who have experienced, or fear experiencing, the failure of law enforcement to make this country a place where people can live with the assurance that their fundamental rights will be respected," she said.
The PNP earlier said that they have yet to report any threat against Duterte and her family when she first made her statement.
GMA News Online reached out to the PNP for a comment on Duterte's latest pronouncements. —RF, GMA News
